_comment: HAND-COMPUTED expectations for probes/widgets/popup/Main.as. Never regenerate these by running the probe.

_derivation.geometry: Window 380x520; root column, padding 20, gap 12, alignItems flex-start, white. Children in order: box 'top' (size [240,34], padding 0) holding the select, box 'lower' (size [240,180], fill 0x1E3A8A), combobox (width 240), datePicker (width 240). All three pickers use SELECT_TRIGGER, whose height is FIXED at 34 with no border, so the stack is top y=20, lower y=20+34+12=66, cb y=66+180+12=258, dp y=258+34+12=304. The select is nested on purpose: its owner has to sit at a NON-ZERO offset, otherwise a lift that keeps the parent-relative x is indistinguishable from a correct one.
_derivation.final_frame: The last phase unmounts the select (model.showSel = false) while it is OPEN and therefore lifted. 'top' has an explicit 240x34 size, so the rows below keep their y; the box is simply empty (it paints nothing) and every picker is closed.
points: (100,30) is inside the now-empty 'top' box, which paints nothing -> the root's white. A LEAKED lifted select sprite would still sit there painting its grey trigger 0xF3F4F6, which is why this point is worth pinning.
(230,95) is 29px into the 180-tall card -> the card's fill 0x1E3A8A. The open-list phases assert this same point is a dropdown row instead.
(230,312) is inside the date picker's trigger (304..338) -> 0xF3F4F6 (SELECT_TRIGGER background).
_derivation.not_pinned: The mid-run states cannot live here because expect.json only describes ONE frame: the open list's row colours (#DBEAFE on the selected row, #FFFFFF on the others), the combobox's white list over the date picker's grey trigger, the lifted display order (above the main tree, below the overlay tree), the absolute x/y of a lifted backing and the stage-container child counts are all asserted inside Main.as and reported through <OUT>.done.
